auth_finding: API key authentication via x-api-key header matching API_KEY env var; /api/download also validates api_token_enabled() from /data/api_enabled.json; missing/invalid key returns 403.
endpoint_contract: GET /api/download?url=<url>&fmt=mp4|mp3&q=<int> requires x-api-key header (or api_key query param) matching API_KEY env; returns HTTP 200 with streaming media + Content-Disposition header when authorized; returns 403 when API token disabled or API key invalid/missing.
verification: cat /data/api_enabled.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'file not found'; cat /data/proxies_active.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'file not found'
